reviews.title: Complete AS2 foundation areas 1-6 and adjacent Accessibility, Video, and loader APIs
reviews.summary: Implements and verifies #initclip/#endinitclip, intrinsic declarations, MovieClip.beginBitmapFill, tellTarget, ifFrameLoaded, call, _level0/_levelN, variable.scroll/maxscroll, Accessibility and _accProps, Video typing and deblocking, MovieClipLoader.removeListener and load lifecycle callbacks, and checkPolicyFile validation across MovieClipLoader, Sound, and NetStream.

entries.note: Evaluates 1..=_totalframes, frame labels, and scene names on the current MovieClip timeline; self-contained HTML5 bundles preload all authored frames up front rather than progressive SWF frame streaming.

_level0 resolves to the main publication root timeline independently of _lockroot across expressions, target paths, and eval(); _levelN (N >= 1) resolves to undefined because multi-SWF levels are outside single-document HTML5 exports.

Validates and stores integer 0..=5 on VideoState in shared Rust and resets on restart; browser HTML5 <video> decoders manage post-processing internally rather than applying Flash On2/Sorenson deblocking levels.
Validates and stores Boolean checkPolicyFile state on MovieClipLoader instances; browser CORS replaces Flash crossdomain.xml policy-file fetches in HTML5.
Validates and stores Boolean checkPolicyFile state on AS2 Sound instances; browser CORS replaces Flash crossdomain.xml policy-file fetches in HTML5.
Validates and stores Boolean checkPolicyFile state on AS2 NetStream instances; browser CORS replaces Flash crossdomain.xml policy-file fetches in HTML5.
